arm.description: Which arm

behavior.name: segment
behavior.description: SAM3 segmentation of the latest image of a camera. Give exactly one of a text prompt or a positive point [row, col]. behavior.name: point
behavior.description: Molmo points at what a short noun phrase names in a camera's latest image ('the radio on the table'). Returns the pixel, its world xyz through the depth (median of a 7x7 window) and the image with the point marked.

query.description: A short noun phrase, e.g. 'the radio on the table'

behavior.name: back_project
behavior.description: World xyz of a pixel (row, col; row 0 = top) in a camera's latest image, through its metric depth (median of a 3x3 window). Region mode: row_range + col_range returns the median and the xy midpoint over that window.

behavior.name: detect
behavior.description: SAM3 masks on a camera's current image, each with a short id (d3) drawn on the returned overlay in rank order (red, blue, green, yellow, ...). all.description: Every mask, not only the best (default false)

behavior.name: select_detection
behavior.description: Choose one detect mask (by id) as the target of the current observation, after checking the overlay.

id.description: A detection id of the current observation (d3)

behavior.name: reject_detection
behavior.description: Rule out one detect mask (by id) of the current observation; it stays listed as rejected.

id.description: A detection id of the current observation (d3)

behavior.name: enhance_depth
behavior.description: Fill the holes of a camera's current depth with a UniDepth estimate scaled to the sensor, or supply depth where the camera has none. detect then measures through it until the next motion.

geometry_third_person_wrist.description: Move the grip site (the point between the finger pads) and orient it, then open or close. Position: at most one of xyz (world m), point_id (a solved mark_point) or delta_mm (delta_frame world = [dX,dY,dZ], grip_site = [dJAW,dLAT,dAPP] along the gripper's current axes); omitted keeps the position. Orientation: approach is the world direction the gripper points along (its +Z; [0,0,-1] = straight down), jaw the world direction the fingers close along (its +X; either sign); give either or both, omitted parts keep the current orientation. preview=true only draws the target (zoomed preview_top/front/side views, markable, and the camera). A close is always previewed first: the result's preview_id, executed unchanged by move_grip({execute_preview_id}) alone while the gripper has not moved; any change needs a new preview. The preview is geometry: it does not predict contact. After a motion: motion_status reached or not_reached (then the gripper is skipped), grip_xyz_m, remaining_delta_mm, rotation_error_deg, gripper_width (closed_on_nothing: no grasp), and in simulation the robot's contacts (cyan on the camera image).

point_id.description: A solved mark_point id as the position

approach.description: World direction of the gripper's approach axis (+Z)

jaw.description: World direction of the jaw (closing) axis (+X)

gripper.description: After the motion

execute_preview_id.description: Execute a frozen close preview; give it alone
